title: GOOD: keygen sets private key mode to 0600 at file open time not chmod
description: keygen.rs: on Unix, the private key file is opened with OpenOptionsExt::mode(0o600) so the mode is set in the open(2) call before any data is written. This avoids the TOCTOU race of create-then-chmod where the file could be read by other processes in the window between creation and chmod. Decision: correct pattern. Any future file write of sensitive material must use mode() at open time.
